Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of THDC India Limited payable at Rishikesh . rection, testing and commissioning to THDCIL.
